deadEnd.details: Search results load, but selecting any fare (Main Basic or Main Classic) redirects to Book a Flight with 'We're sorry, but there was a problem processing your request. Please go back and try again. #SFAF039_444'. Reproduced three times on 2026-10-02 in fresh proxy sessions, with both the Switzerland-English and United States-English locales. No CAPTCHA is shown and detectChallenge() reports nothing.

gotchas: From a non-US egress a 'Language Selection' dialog opens on load; 'Select other Location and Language' -> North America -> United States - English, then confirm 'United States - English' in the second dialog. A cookie banner ('Accept All') also shows.

Search form: click role=button[name=/^Origin,/], type the code into role=textbox[name="Origin"] key by key and click the role=option starting with the code; same for the destination button (name ends 'Destination'). Trip Type is a combobox with a 'One Way' option; dates via role=button[name=/^Flight Date Field/] then role=gridcell[name="October 23, 2026"] and the 'Done Button'. Then 'Find Flights'.

On results, the 'Delta Main' button opens a product-info modal; click the price under it to open 'Select an Experience to Continue'. Main Basic's Select needs the 'Accept Restrictions' checkbox; Main Classic's Select does not.
Fare selection then fails with error #SFAF039_444 (see deadEnd). The page can also crash the tab right after selection (Unknown pageId).
